_comment: pack-v3: pack-v2 verbatim, plus the interview phrasings — the wording that wraps a schema question in Viva's manner. The schema pack supplies the plain question and the benefit; this supplies the voice around them. A released pack is never edited; add pack-v4 instead.
identity: I've read a statement for {account_ref}, but I can't yet tell whose account it is. Is it one you already have with me, or shall I set it up as a new one?
reconciliation_gap: Your {account_ref} statement for {opening_date} – {closing_date} doesn't continue from the balance I hold. A statement in between looks to be missing — do you happen to have one?
reconciliation_gap_why: It opens at {opening_money}; my chain ends elsewhere.
reconciliation_flagged: Your {account_ref} statement didn't add up, so I haven't put it on your books. When you have a moment, could you check the figure I flagged?
reconciliation_held: I'm holding a {doc_type} {for_account} that didn't reconcile, so its figures aren't on your books yet. Nothing is lost — it is simply waiting for us.
transfer: On {date} you moved {money} ({description}). Was that money moving between your own accounts, rather than being spent?
transfer_why: {candidates} movement(s) of the same amount within a few days on another account you hold.
merchant: May I ask what {example} is? You have {count} transaction(s) with it, {money} in total.
merchant_peer_note: (This looks like a payment to a person, so I'll only apply your answer here — not as a rule.)
merchant_why: I don't yet have a category for this merchant.
nature_single: {date}: {description} — {money}. Could you tell me what this one was for?
nature_single_why: The description names how the money moved, not who received it — so I have to ask about each one separately.
nature_group_compound: A payment like that is usually several things at once, and I can't tell the split without the paperwork — I would rather ask than guess.
nature_group_ask: Shall I set that up for you?
nature_group_why: Because of who they are, not because of anything you told me.
nature_group_why_documents: Your {documents} would let me prove it, not just assume it.
corroboration: You've told me about {name} — {money} so far. If you have the {document}, I could prove this rather than just record it. Entirely at your convenience.
corroboration_why: This account exists because you said so; nothing has attested it yet.
corroboration_why_unreliable: Its balance also can't be trusted yet, because part of those payments was interest.
free_text_invite: Or tell me in your own words
expectation_retirement_flow: Your pay has been setting money aside for retirement — {money} so far — but I've never seen the account it lands in. Do you have a {document}? It would let me show that money growing, rather than just leaving.
expectation_retirement_flow_why: Every pay stub shows the deduction; no statement has ever shown the destination.
expectation_investment_account: You hold {account_name}. Its {document} would tell me what was truly gained or lost — detail I currently have to leave aside. Do you have this year's?
expectation_investment_account_why: Realized gains and dividends of {money} are on your books; the tax form is what attests them.
expectation_account_cadence: My picture of {account_name} ends at {last_date}. A newer statement likely exists — whenever you have it, I'll bring things current.
expectation_account_cadence_why: Nothing is wrong — the account is simply not current, and I would rather say so than pretend.
interview_why: You've told me this one exists; there are just a few things I still need to know about it.
interview_opens: You mentioned there's a {kind_label} against your {name}. Shall we set that one up too, so the two read together?
